user.title: Initial setup
user.description: Choose the weather source, set indoor comfort values, and optionally pick notification devices.

data_description.outdoor_weather_entity_id: Choose the standard Home Assistant weather entity VentWise can use today. If you do not see the source you need, open a GitHub issue.
data_description.target_temperature_c: Set the indoor temperature that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.auto_comfort_temperature: Uses your comfort temperature as a baseline and adjusts it gradually from the perceived outdoor temperature. The adjustment is limited to ±2°C within an 18–26°C indoor safety range. Room sensors determine the recommendation but never move the target. This does not control a thermostat or HVAC system.
data_description.target_humidity_percent: Set the indoor humidity that feels comfortable when you are home.
data_description.stability_minutes: How long the recommendation must stay unchanged before VentWise notifies you. If you are not sure, leave the default value.
data_description.notification_device_id: Optional. Pick one or more devices that should receive VentWise notifications.
data_description.home_assistant_notification_enabled: Show each VentWise recommendation in Home Assistant's notification panel.
data_description.diagnostic_notification_level: Choose whether Home Assistant shows extra notifications for configuration or sensor-data problems.
data_description.debug_mode_enabled: Shows per-room open and close notification test controls. Confirming a debug notification can run the configured automation.
data_description.co2_enabled: Optional. Used only for advisory ventilation recommendations; VentWise does not control devices.
data_description.co2_entity_id: Optional. Used only for advisory ventilation recommendations; VentWise does not control devices.
data_description.co2_threshold_ppm: Optional. Used only for advisory ventilation recommendations; VentWise does not control devices.
